content: The time it takes for a solar panel to become carbon neutral (meaning the energy it has produced has offset the energy used in its production) varies depending on many factors. These can include the intensity of sunlight where it's located, the efficiency of the panel itself, etc. However, studies generally estimate this time to be about 1-5 years. After this point, the clean energy produced by the solar panel continues to offset carbon emissions, reducing the overall carbon footprint.
